attempts.summary: Configured dnsmasq on node1 (Alpine 3.23) to resolve inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.231.11) while forwarding all other queries to the upstream resolver (10.100.231.1). Configured node2's /etc/resolv.conf to use node1 (10.100.231.10) as its DNS resolver, with dhcpcd's resolv.conf hook disabled (nohook resolv.conf) so the setting persists across DHCP renewals and reboots. Verified end-to-end resolution from node2 for both the internal name and external names. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured healthy baselines, restarted node1 and node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed changed boot_id on each, and confirmed DNS service/config and resolution fully recovered post-restart on both nodes.
